_note: Building evolution (docs/rehber/04_bina_evrimi.md §2, §10): six look tiers per building. One seed per building for all its tiers and its function words first, then the tier's material and light keys (§10 prompt guide), so the six read as one building growing. SDXL reads 77 tokens: asset prompt plus style stay under that. Height grows by the tier's silhouette factor (1, 1.15, 1.32, 1.52, 1.75, 2.01 of tier I, at most 8 m) from today's model; footprint caps the width so a tier never spills into the next slot. Domes start at tier II. Production order (§11): core reactor, then tiers I-III of every building, then IV-VI. props.py: motion static (origin at the bottom), budget 3000-5500 triangles by tier, 1024 px bake.
style: single game building, three-quarter view, plain light grey background, hand-painted, deep sea sci-fi
negative: multiple objects, cropped, text, logo, watermark, people, scenery, water surface, floor, shadow on floor, blurry, photo
